svg.text: Q5: radii 7.5 on both edges of a 10 wide face over a 6 high wall
each fillet runs past the wall: its pivot is the bottom edge; at once the two pivot results intersect
A. intersection of the two pivot results (CHOSEN)
each fillet takes its own pivot arc (through the
bottom edge of its wall); the arcs cross at 143.5 deg.
IsDone false (8.0.1, and IR before this series).
C. clamp to the wall (6 and 6)
smaller radii that fit the wall; the arcs still cross.
